candidats.titre: File:15. Window Frame and Masonry Reconstruction. (23928803-983f-4ef4-9792-ac9f5e393134).jpg
candidats.description: Two members of the preservation crew are bent over working on reconstructing the masonry walls around the half exposed window frame. There is a red scaffold in the background and a white tarp over the exposed section of the house they are working on. There is a black and white sign leaning against the white, wooden window frame that reads "Gettysburg NMP Warfield House Laying Stone Gable North Wall PEPC 85531 8-31-20 Smith." Preservationists install a wooden window frame in a historic window opening which was removed during the early part of the 20th century. Work begins on reconstructing sect
